text:
```yaml
name: PR Preview Artifact & Cloudflare

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'website/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  build-and-preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: website/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: website
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build website
        working-directory: website
        run: npm run build

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: website-preview
          path: website/dist
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages
        id: deploy
        if: env.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN != '' && env.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID != ''
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          command: pages deploy website/dist --project-name=razorconsole-preview --branch=pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}

      - name: Post PR Comment
        uses: marocchino/sticky-pull-request-comment@v2
        with:
          header: Preview
          message: |
            ## Preview Deployment
            
            ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.deployment-url != '' && format('🚀 **Live Preview**: [View Site]({0})', steps.deploy.outputs.deployment-url) || '📦 **Artifact Only**: Cloudflare secrets not configured. Download the artifact below to preview locally.' }}
            
            ### Download Artifact
            1. Go to the [Actions tab](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }})
            2. Download the `website-preview` artifact
            3. Extract and open `index.html` in your browser
```
